text_block_list.text:
One day, we're volunteering to play with
some
children at a nearby kindergarten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик deftly chases the children
around the
playground, until...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She accidently hits her head full force on
the
playground equipment and sinks to
the ground.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... That bump earlier really startled me.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I was seeing stars right when I
smacked
my head...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But after that, my mind actually felt
surprisingly
clear. I had a really easy
time running for some
reason.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe... Maybe I can use this to
my
advantage in races?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hey, can we go back to the academy
and test it
out?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: You're going to hit your head again?!

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! No, no! I just want to try running
again.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
If all goes well, maybe I can make you
smile even
wider! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик appears to have figured
something
out by hitting her head, and
her running
noticeably improves!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
